rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Google Meet and Calendar integration server built by INSIDE-HAIR that provides 23+ validated tools for managing Google Calendar events and Google Meet spaces through both Calendar API v3 and Meet API v2. The implementation supports multiple authentication methods (direct tokens, file-based OAuth, legacy credentials), comprehensive Zod validation schemas with business logic enforcement, and includes advanced monitoring capabilities with health checks, metrics collection, and Prometheus integration. Features Docker deployment options, Smithery platform compatibility, and extensive error handling optimized for AI assistance, making it useful for automated meeting scheduling, calendar management workflows, conference recording and transcript retrieval, and AI-powered productivity applications that need deep Google Workspace integration.
